# ProductCategory

`from xurrent import ProductCategory` · module `xurrent.product_categories` · API resource `/product_categories` · [Xurrent API docs](https://developer.xurrent.com/v1/product_categories/)

A product category that groups products and sets their rule set (e.g. physical asset or
software).
